description: This file defines a dictionary of canned responses and a class 'ProbotMessenger' for sending messages via a bot, used for communication and logging in a repository management context.

classes.name: ProbotMessenger
classes.description: A class for sending predefined messages to a GitHub repository via a bot, encapsulating message templates and the send method.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the ProbotMessenger with repository info and optional comment ID.

methods.name: send
methods.description: Formats and sends a message based on a key and optional parameters to the repository via the bot.
